svg.title: EA frequency in solved GP pages and doublets in unsolved LP2
svg.desc: Solved LP1 has 20 EA events in 2782 within-page positions, or 0.719 percent. Unsolved LP2 has 86 doublets in 12901 positions, or 0.667 percent. The rates are close but do not identify a cipher.

g.text: EA frequency and the doublet count
Different corpora and measurements; the proposed rule connects them only conditionally
Similarity of rates is not independent evidence for the running-sum equation.
